entries.description: MCP Server Card for the remote BCV Today MCP server at https://mcp.bcv.today/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no authentication). Tools: get_latest_rates, get_rate_by_date, get_history, convert and get_status, backed by the official Banco Central de Venezuela rates for USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolivar.
representativeQueries: MCP server for the official Venezuelan exchange rate
convert dollars to bolivars at the BCV rate
¿cuál fue la tasa del dólar BCV el 2 de enero de 2026?
historial del euro BCV de los últimos 30 días

entries.description: A2A Agent Card for the BCV Today Rates Agent at https://mcp.bcv.today/a2a (A2A JSON-RPC binding, protocol 1.0 and 0.3, stateless, no authentication). Deterministic agent that answers in Spanish or English, or from a structured DataPart, with the official Banco Central de Venezuela rates: latest rates, rate on a date, conversions, history and data freshness.
representativeQueries: A2A agent for the official Venezuelan exchange rate
agente A2A para consultar la tasa del BCV
convertir 100 dólares a bolívares a la tasa BCV
USD to VES rate on a given date

entries.description: OpenAPI 3.1 description of the free, public, read-only static JSON API with the official Banco Central de Venezuela exchange rates (USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolivar): latest rate, daily history, single-day snapshots and status. No authentication.
representativeQueries: ¿cuál es el dólar BCV hoy?
official USD to VES exchange rate today
tasa oficial del euro BCV
BCV exchange rate history API

entries.description: Static JSON file with the BCV rates currently in effect for USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolivar, with effective_date and updated_at. Changes at most once per business day.
representativeQueries: precio del dólar oficial en Venezuela hoy
current BCV dollar rate in bolivars
tasa BCV del día en bolívares

entries.description: Plain-text agent index for the site: API endpoints, data notes, Markdown versions of the pages and discovery documents.
representativeQueries: how do I use the BCV Today API
documentación de la API de tasas BCV

entries.description: RFC 9727 API catalog linkset pointing to the OpenAPI description, API documentation, status endpoint and agent metadata.
representativeQueries: BCV Today API catalog
list the APIs published by bcv.today

entries.description: Agent Skills index listing the bcv-rates skill, which explains how to fetch official BCV exchange rates and history from the static JSON API.
representativeQueries: skill to fetch BCV exchange rates
consultar el historial de la tasa BCV por fecha

entries.description: Official zero-dependency Python client and bcv command-line tool for the BCV Today API (pip install bcv): latest official Banco Central de Venezuela rates, rate on a date with weekend carry-forward, history and Decimal conversions between VES, USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB. Python 3.9+.
representativeQueries: Python library for the official BCV exchange rate
librería Python para la tasa del dólar BCV
convert USD to VES in Python at the BCV rate

entries.description: Official zero-dependency JavaScript/TypeScript client for the BCV Today API (npm install bcv-today): latest official Banco Central de Venezuela rates, rate on a date with weekend carry-forward, history and exact decimal conversions between VES, USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB, plus the bcv-today CLI. ESM and CommonJS; Node.js 18+, Deno, Bun, browsers and Cloudflare Workers.
representativeQueries: JavaScript library for the official BCV exchange rate
librería npm para la tasa del dólar BCV
convert USD to VES in TypeScript at the BCV rate

entries.description: Free Odoo module that updates each company's currency rates daily with the official Banco Central de Venezuela rate (USD, EUR, CNY, TRY, RUB) from the BCV Today API, dated with the BCV value date, with a history backfill wizard. Odoo 16.0 to 20.0, Community and Enterprise, Odoo.sh or on-premise; not available on Odoo Online. Source: https://github.com/grupoclip/odoo-bcv-rate.
representativeQueries: Odoo module for the official BCV exchange rate
módulo de Odoo para actualizar la tasa BCV automáticamente
tasa del dólar BCV en Odoo 19

entries.description: Official zero-dependency PHP 8.1+ client for the BCV Today API (composer require grupoclip/bcv-today): latest official Banco Central de Venezuela rates, rate on a date with weekend carry-forward, history and exact decimal conversions between VES, USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB, with a Laravel service provider and facade.
representativeQueries: PHP library for the official BCV dollar rate
librería PHP para la tasa del dólar BCV
Laravel package for Venezuela exchange rates

entries.description: Official standard-library-only Go client for the BCV Today API (go get github.com/grupoclip/bcv-api/packages/go): latest official Banco Central de Venezuela rates, rate on a date with weekend carry-forward, history, exact decimal conversions and the bcv command-line tool.
representativeQueries: Go package for the BCV exchange rate
módulo de Go para la tasa BCV
golang convert dollars to bolivars

entries.description: Embeddable web component that shows today's official BCV rate on any website with one script tag: card, inline or converter, Spanish or English, light or dark. The page has a live configurator that generates the HTML.
representativeQueries: show the BCV dollar rate on my website
widget de la tasa del dólar BCV para mi página
embed Venezuela exchange rate

entries.displayName: BCV Today Telegram bot and channel
entries.description: Telegram bot @BCVTodayBot with the official BCV rates (/dolar, /tasas, /convertir 100 usd, /historial, daily subscription, inline mode in any chat) and the public channel @bcvtoday (https://t.me/bcvtoday), which posts each newly published dollar rate.
representativeQueries: Telegram bot for the BCV dollar rate
bot de Telegram con la tasa del dólar BCV
canal de Telegram con la tasa BCV diaria
